_comment: SIH26038 Phase 6 — unified explainability. Descriptive layer only: never alters prediction/probabilities. ENGINEERING HEURISTICS throughout.

gradcam.comment: Predicted-class path reuses Phase 1 make_gradcam_heatmap unchanged. Targeted path uses the generic adapter below.

overlap.comment: Binary masks: nearest-neighbor. Heatmaps: bilinear. No coordinate shifts (verified by test).

consistency.comment: Spatial-agreement categories between Grad-CAM and explicit evidence. NOT diagnostic certainty.

ranking.comment: Deterministic region ranking for explanation usefulness (NOT clinical severity). Weights sum to 1.

faithfulness.comment: Deletion check: mask top-activation pixels (fraction below), fill with blurred image, measure P(predicted) drop. Sanity check, NOT causal proof.
